prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a parking lot collision claim. Injury: back strain. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1206; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following a report of a low-speed collision in a parking lot. Insured vehicle was stationary and struck on the rear quarter panel by a third-party vehicle reversing out of a space. Both drivers exited and exchanged information. Police not called. Photos of both vehicles received from insured. Claimant reports minor back strain at the scene and was advised to seek medical evaluation.

Entry 2: Third-party carrier acknowledged liability coverage review. Claimant's attorney has entered a representation notice and requests that all further contact be directed to counsel. Preservation letter sent for security footage from the lot. Property damage estimate requested from the appraisal vendor.

Entry 3: Appraisal received for the claimant vehicle showing rear bumper replacement and quarter panel repair. Estimate reviewed and found consistent with photographs. Rental coverage confirmed under the third-party policy for the duration of repairs. Medical records requested through counsel, including initial urgent care notes and follow-up chiropractic treatment.

Entry 4: Attorney's office provided a demand package describing lumbar strain with ongoing physical therapy. Records indicate two urgent care visits and a course of twelve therapy sessions. Treating provider notes limited restriction from heavy lifting for three weeks. Medical bills under review. Coverage counsel consulted regarding bodily injury evaluation timeline.

Entry 5: Surveillance footage obtained from the lot operator shows the third-party vehicle reversing at low speed with no evident pedestrian or vehicle conflict beyond the contact. Liability assessment updated to reflect primary fault on the third-party driver. Reserve adjusted pending completion of medical review. Next action: follow up with counsel on records status and schedule independent medical review.
